title: Stays Counted toward the Superhost Stays Bonus after a Suspension — Host Accounts
content:
# Superhost Perk Terms — Completed Stays Counted for the Stays Bonus after a Suspension (Host Accounts)

**Term.** The completed stays the stays bonus of a Superhost's Roamhaven travel credit pays on are worked out by one of three methods:

(a) for a host whose most recent suspension began within the 12 months before the credit and lasted **at least 14 calendar days**, counted from its suspended date to the date its account suspension appeal was approved, they are the average of the completed stays recorded at the account's Superhost assessments dated within those 12 months **other than the completing assessment**;

(b) for a host whose most recent suspension began within those 12 months and lasted **at least 1 but fewer than 14** such days, they are the average of the completed stays recorded at **all** of the account's Superhost assessments dated within those 12 months;

(c) for any other host no averaging applies.

Each such average is rounded down to a whole stay. A window of 12 months holds the records dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the date of the credit.

## Cases (hypothetical Host Accounts records)

Superhost assessments dated within the 12 months before the credit recorded 12, 11 and 9 completed stays, and the completing assessment recorded 6.

| Most recent suspension | Stays counted |
|---|---|
| Began 4 months before the credit, lasted 20 days | 12, 11 and 9 averaged: 10.67, rounded down to **10** |
| Began 4 months before the credit, lasted 5 days | 12, 11, 9 and 6 averaged: 9.5, rounded down to **9** |
| Began 14 months before the credit, lasted 20 days | No averaging applies |
| No suspension on record | No averaging applies |

## Points of judgement

- The suspension's length runs to the approval of its account suspension appeal, not to the date of the credit.
- Under (a) the completing assessment is left out of the average; under (b) it is included.
